notes.title: Version 2.0 Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! Version 2.0 of Spare Parts: Episode 2 is now available to download. It features:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved sprites[/p][/*][*][p]A lot of small/medium edits[/p][/*][*][p]Small changes to match the Episode 1 update[/p][/*][*][p]New UI[/p][/*][/list][p]
...And some other small things! It's not nearly as extensive an update as [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479310/Spare_Parts_Episode_1/"]Episode 1's[/url], but I put a lot of work in to improve the writing in small ways, as well as updating the sprites and UI.[/p][p]
Let me also take this opportunity to say that Episode 3 is, indeed, still in development. An early access version is available elsewhere, if you're interested in such a thing. You can follow me on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/sopy.itch.io"]Bluesky[/url] if you'd like more updates about that.[/p][p]
If you run into any issues, please feel free to contact me at [url="https://sofycrystals@gmail.com"]sofycrystals@gmail.com[/url]. Thank you![/p]
